The '''underslug''' was a small creature seen on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. The green and orange creature crawled along the ground and could blend into grass. It would raise up its round head to attack an enemy.

==Behind the scenes==
The creature was first seen in 1991's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1991 video game)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' video game]], and named in the game's manual.
